The function definition stays inside the package unchanged.
3. **No in-repo importer is broken or re-pointed — right.** On `origin/main` `1eb1afae0`: zero imports of `renderNotification` or `interpolate` from the specifier `@objectstack/service-messaging` anywhere in the tree (tests included). Every in-package caller (`email-channel.ts:16`, `sms-channel.ts:16`, `digest-render.ts:5`, and the five test files) imports `./template-renderer.js` directly, so none of them touches the entry and none is edited. Outside `packages/services/service-messaging/src/`, the name `renderNotification` occurs in 0 files: not in `content/docs/**`, not in `README.md`, not in `examples/**`, `apps/**`, `skills/**`, other packages or the ADRs. The dev's measurement agrees. The card records zero in `objectstack-ai/hotcrm`; npm dependants remain unmeasured, which the ruling accepted (axis ②).
4. **Docs still tell the truth — right, vacuously.** No page names the retired export, so nothing goes stale; the Docs Drift Check's "no anchor for index.ts" line is a coverage disclaimer, not a finding, and the hand re-read above found no page to correct. The one doc the diff writes is the hunk comment in `index.ts`, which cites ruling 6335348115 on #25082 and names the replacement door (a `sys_notification_template` row) — consistent with the changeset's FROM → TO line.

The control case guards vacuity (five surviving names asserted as functions / the literal `sys_notification_template`). The ablation is shown in both the PR body and report 6350022822 (base `index.ts` restored → 1 failed, 2 passed; restored with `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty) — one-off, no permanent file, which is the right shape. The file sits under `src`, which the package `tsconfig.json` includes, so it is inside the tsc program (`Type Check · workspace`: success) and inside vitest (`Test Core` 1–6: success). It reads nothing outside its package.
6. **The third pin pins the stored-template door — right.** It builds `createEmailChannel` from the entry with a `NotificationTemplateStore` over a fake data reader, sends one notification, and asserts the exact `email.send` input `email-channel.ts:379-390` constructs: `to`, the interpolated `subject` verbatim, `html` with the payload value HTML-encoded, `organizationId`. That is the path the retired export served internally and the one the changeset says is unchanged.
7. **ADR-0087 disposition is the ruled category and verified on this head — right.** Marker: exactly one, `not-required (runtime-export-retired @objectstack/service-messaging#renderNotification)`; FROM side spelled as the bare export name (the ac294b00 spelling the ruling fixed); all three D9 predicates run in CI inside `Check Changeset`'s step "Require an ADR-0087 disposition on a declared-breaking changeset" (`pr-automation.yml:988-999`, `--base $MERGE_BASE`), and that check-run concluded success on this head. Predicate 2 clears for this operand because `renderNotification` is declared in `template-renderer.ts`, not on any `*.zod.ts`, `contracts/**` or object definition, and the ruling's own re-run recorded the same verdict.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `25190-retire-body-taking-render-exports.md`: `'@objectstack/service-messaging': patch`; title line `fix(service-messaging)!: …` matching the PR title; the **BREAKING** banner present; `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial in BOTH the changeset body and the PR body; one ADR-0087 marker; one FROM → TO line; an "Unchanged" line naming `interpolate`.

The `!` in the title is consistent with the banner. The migration prescription is carried (FROM `renderNotification` TO a `sys_notification_template` row for topic/channel/locale, rendered by the delivering channel), which is what a breaking changeset must ship into `CHANGELOG.md`. No staged window, per the ruling. `Clause-②:` line judged: `no (narrowing)` is correct — a narrowing of the published surface with no widening arm.

Cosmetic, not blocking: the changeset FILE name says "render-exports" (plural) while this PR retires one; the filename is consumed and deleted at release and carries nothing into the CHANGELOG.
